why: fm-server 4.30 lets a manager adjust a participant mid-session, and a holding says what adjustments moved apart from what the session opened with: adjustedCash, and adjustedUnits and adjustedShortUnits per position. The short floor is initialShortUnits plus adjustedShortUnits; an SDK that reads the grant's alone keeps a robot on the old floor after a RIGHTS adjustment, and one that drops adjustedCash or adjustedUnits counts a manager's gift as trading.

source.constructed: No production marketplace has an adjustment yet (fm-server 4.30.0, deployed 2026-11-14); the shape is its Holding and Asset as WireManifestTest holds them. Recapture from GET /v1/marketplaces/{marketplaceId}/participants/me/holding after a session with a cash, units and RIGHTS adjustment.
